title: On Nests and Large Components of Random Real Algebraic Curves
summary: We develop a variant of the barrier method in order to address questions about topology of Kostlan random real algebraic plane curves. In particular we prove that the expected number of connected components of the curve of length at least $\displaystyle{O\left(\sqrt{d^{-1}\log \log d}\right)}$ grows to infinity with $d$, and likewise, the expected number of nests of the curve of depth at least $\displaystyle{O\left(\log\log d\right)}$ grows to infinity with $d$.
